answer.reason: The EIA California Electricity Profile Table 1 reports net generation separately for electric utilities and other producer types; the figure for electric utilities is 75,921,531 megawatthours. The larger total, 138,269,852 megawatthours, represents the combined generation for all producer types, not electric utilities alone.
